column4: Quick note on the Brightwater account. They renewed for one year at the current price.
Good news. Did they ask for anything new?
Only a quarterly business review. I said yes, starting in February.
Fine. I will add it to the account plan and set a reminder for the first review.
Also, their invoice contact changed. The new contact is in the shared folder.
Got it. I will update the billing system today.
One more thing. Their support tickets dropped by a third since the last release.
Let's mention that in the review. It's a good story for the renewal next year.
Agreed. I will pull the ticket numbers for the last two quarters.
Should we offer them the new reporting add on at the review?
Yes, but only as a trial for three months, so there is no pressure on the budget.
